image_description: A close-up, slightly high-angle shot of two stacked audio cassette tapes. The top cassette has a white label with hand-drawn or printed graphics (a blue figure on the left, a beige figure on the right) and black text that appears to read 'MIRACULOUS' or similar, though it is distorted. The bottom cassette has a transparent yellowish casing with a visible brown magnetic tape spool and a small label window showing red text/numbers. The cassettes rest on a dark wooden surface.
